title: Unverified preprint claims matrix-multiplication exponent of 9/4
summary: An unverified preprint hosted on GitHub, titled "The matrix multiplication exponent is nine fourths," claims the matrix-multiplication exponent is 9/4, or Θ\(n^2.25\), over every field. Commenters link it to OpenAI&\#x27;s four new papers and say it addresses open problem \#25 by refuting a conjecture, but the posting has no disclosed peer review, methodology, or model recipe. If the claim holds, it would be a landmark complexity-theory result; as posted, it has not been independently validated.
